message.content:
**Paris Get‑away: 7‑Day Itinerary (Mid‑April 2025)**  
*(Assumes you’re flying from New York City – JFK – to Paris‑Charles de Gaulle (CDG). Adjust dates and transport as needed.)*

| Day | Time | Activity | Notes |
|-----|------|----------|-------|
| **Day 1 – Arrival** | 08:00 AM | Flight from JFK to CDG (approx. 7 h) | Direct flight, e.g., Air France or Delta. |
| | 02:00 PM | Arrive CDG, take RER B to Gare du Nord → Metro Line 4 to **Châtelet‑Les Halles** | 30 min ride, €10.50 single fare. |
| | 03:30 PM | Check‑in at **Hotel Le Meurice** (5★) | 2‑starroom, €350/night. |
| | 05:00 PM | Walk to **Tuileries Garden** | Relax, photo ops. |
| | 07:00 PM | Dinner at **Le Cinq** (Michelin 3★) | €200 per person (incl. wine). |
| | 09:30 PM | Night stroll along the Seine | Light walk to Notre‑Dame. |
| **Day 2 – Classic Highlights** | 08:00 AM | Breakfast at hotel | Included. |
| | 09:00 AM | Visit **Louvre Museum** | Pre‑book tickets, 2 hrs. |
| | 12:00 PM | Lunch at **Café Marly** | €35 per person. |
| | 01:30 PM | Walk to **Notre‑Dame** & **Sainte‑Chapelle** | 1 hr. |
| | 04:00 PM | Explore **Latin Quarter** | Book a guided walking tour. |
| | 07:00 PM | Dinner at **Le Procope** (oldest café) | €45 per person. |
| **Day 3 – Montmartre & Art** | 08:30 AM | Breakfast at **Ladurée** | €25 per person. |
| | 09:30 AM | Take Metro Line 12 to **Abbesses** | 15 min. |
| | 10:00 AM | Visit **Sacré‑Coeur** & **Place du Tertre** | 2 hrs. |
| | 01:00 PM | Lunch at **La Maison Rose** | €30 per person. |
| | 02:30 PM | Visit **Musée de Montmartre** | 1 hr. |
| | 05:00 PM | Return to hotel, relax |  |
| | 07:30 PM | Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** | €40 per person. |
| **Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles** | 07:30 AM | Breakfast at hotel |  |
| | 08:30 AM | Take RER C to **Versailles Château** | 30 min, €7.50 return. |
| | 09:30 AM | Guided tour of the palace & gardens | 3 hrs. |
| | 01:00 PM | Picnic lunch (pre‑packed) | €15 per person. |
| | 04:00 PM | Return to Paris |  |
| | 06:30 PM | Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower) | €250 per person. |
| **Day 5 – Modern & Shopping** | 09:00 AM | Breakfast at **Café de Flore** | €30 per person. |
| | 10:30 AM | Visit **Centre Pompidou** | 2 hrs. |
| | 01:00 PM | Lunch at **Le Georges** (Pompidou roof) | €35 per person. |
| | 02:30 PM | Shopping on **Avenue des Champs‑Élysées** | 3 hrs. |
| | 05:30 PM | Visit **Arc de Triomphe** | 1 hr. |
| | 07:30 PM | Dinner at **L’Ambroisie** (Michelin 3★) | €220 per person. |
| **Day 6 – Leisure & Culture** | 10:00 AM | Breakfast at hotel |  |
| | 11:00 AM | Visit **Musée d’Orsay** | 2 hrs. |
| | 01:30 PM | Lunch at **Le Café Marly** | €35 per person. |
| | 03:00 PM | Relax at **Jardin du Luxembourg** | 2 hrs. |
| | 06:00 PM | Attend a **Ballet** at Palais Garnier | €120 per person. |
| | 09:00 PM | Late dinner at **Septime** (Michelin 1★) | €180 per person. |
| **Day 7 – Departure** | 08:00 AM | Breakfast at hotel |  |
| | 09:00 AM | Check‑out, store luggage at concierge |  |
| | 10:00 AM | Last‑minute shopping at **Galeries Lafayette** |  |
| | 12:00 PM | Lunch at **Café Pouchkine** | €30 per person. |
| | 02:00 PM | Retrieve luggage, head to CDG |  |
| | 04:00 PM | Flight back to JFK |  |

---

## Budget Overview (per person)

| Category | Cost |
|----------|------|
| Flights (round‑trip) | €650 |
| Accommodation (6 nights, 2‑starroom) | €2,100 |
| Dining (average €70/day) | €490 |
| Attractions & tours | €300 |
| Transport (metro, RER, taxis) | €150 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €200 |
| **Total** | **≈ €4,030** |

*(Prices are approximate and may vary by season. Book early for best rates.)*

---

## Practical Tips

| Topic | Recommendation |
|-------|----------------|
| **Transport** | Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (valid 1–5 days) for unlimited metro/RER. |
| **Language** | Basic French phrases help; most staff speak English. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables in a money belt; watch for pickpockets in tourist areas. |
| **Weather** | April: 10–18 °C, occasional showers. Pack a light raincoat and comfortable shoes. |
| **Connectivity** | Buy a local SIM (€20 for 30 days) or use Wi‑Fi in cafés. |
| **Cultural Etiquette** | Greet with “Bonjour” before ordering; keep phone on silent in restaurants. |

---

## Optional Add‑Ons

| Activity | Cost | Notes |
|----------|------|-------|
| **Seine River Cruise** | €25 | Evening cruise with dinner. |
| **Wine Tasting** | €60 | Guided tasting at **La Cave à la Cigarette**. |
| **Cooking Class** | €120 | French pastry workshop. |
| **Day Trip to Giverny** | €80 | Monet’s garden. |

Feel free to tweak the itinerary—swap a museum for a day in the Marais, or add a spa day at **Spa Nuxe**. Enjoy your Paris adventure!
